name: separator
title: Separator
description: Horizontal or vertical dividing line, decorative by default, with an optional label in the middle such as "or".

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the line. A vertical separator stretches to the height of its flex parent.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Purely visual line with role=none. Set to false when the line separates meaningful sections, which adds role=separator and aria-orientation.

props.name: label
props.description: Short text in the middle of the line, such as "or".

a11y: Decorative separators use role=none so screen readers skip them.
With decorative=false the element gets role=separator and aria-orientation; a label also becomes its aria-label.
The label text uses muted, which meets AA contrast in light and dark mode.

ai.whenToUse: Dividing groups of content in a card, menu, toolbar, or form, such as the "or" between social sign-in and email sign-in.
rules: Keep it decorative unless the line marks a real boundary between sections
Use a vertical separator only inside a flex row so it can stretch
Keep the label to one or two words

id.description: Garis pemisah horizontal atau vertikal, dekoratif secara default, dengan label opsional di tengah garis seperti "atau".

props.orientation: Arah garis. Separator vertikal merentang setinggi induk flex-nya.
props.decorative: Garis visual saja dengan role=none. Isi false bila garis memisahkan bagian yang bermakna, sehingga memakai role=separator dan aria-orientation.
props.label: Teks singkat di tengah garis, misalnya "atau".

a11y: Separator dekoratif memakai role=none sehingga dilewati pembaca layar.
Dengan decorative=false elemen memakai role=separator dan aria-orientation; label juga menjadi aria-label-nya.
Teks label memakai muted yang memenuhi kontras AA di mode terang dan gelap.

ai.whenToUse: Memisahkan kelompok konten di kartu, menu, toolbar, atau form, misalnya "atau" di antara login sosial dan login email.
rules: Biarkan dekoratif kecuali garis menandai batas nyata antarbagian
Pakai separator vertikal hanya di dalam baris flex agar bisa merentang
Label cukup satu atau dua kata
